newsitem.title: USA: AMBAC qualifies 15 muni issues for bond insurance.
newsitem.headline: AMBAC qualifies 15 muni issues for bond insurance.

text.p: AMBAC Indemnity Corp said it has qualified for bond insurance the following 15 municipal issues scheduled for competitive sale today.
--Bartow County, Ga., $20 million general obligation sales tax bonds.
--N. Highlands Regional High School, N.J., $2.650 million school bonds.
--South Brunswick Ed., N.J., $49.7 million school refunding bonds.
--Ballston Spa CSD, N.Y., $32.4 million school district bonds.
--Ithaca City CSD, N.Y., $10.5 million school district bonds.
--South Colonie CSD, N.Y., $3.246 million school district GOs.
--Sweet Home CSD, N.Y., $6.1 million school district GOs.
--Valley Stream, N.Y., $4.233 million various purpose bonds.
--Lufkin, Texas, $3.025 million water and sewer bonds.
